title: Ace Up The Sleeve
description: Drop to 4 hearts and trigger your Last Stand — summoning Guardian golems and granting powerful buffs to turn the tide of battle.
body:
**⚔️ Overview
Ace up the Sleeve is a Minecraft datapack that gives you one last fighting chance when you're on the brink of death. When things look hopeless, your ace activates turning the tide at the worst possible moment.

🛡️ How It Works
When your health drops to 4 hearts or below, the Last Stand ability triggers automatically. Two Guardian iron golems are summoned to fight by your side, and you are granted Strength, Resistance, and Regeneration buffs to help you survive the chaos.
![When your health is below 3 hearts, the last stand feature is activated summoning 2 Iron golems and giving you these effects for 5 minutes with a cooldown of 10 minutes!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3b0a9cd3163ee4dcec7ff3fa19b7fc6e448b38f.jpeg)

⏱️ Cooldown & Duration
The ability comes with a 10-minute cooldown to keep gameplay balanced. The Guardian golems last 2 minutes before despawning, giving you just enough time to turn the fight around.

✅ Compatibility
Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.17 through 1.21.1 (Mounts of Mayhem).

📦 Installation
Drop the datapack into your world's datapacks folder and reload. That's it. The ability is active automatically for all survival players.

Made by Creator Studios**
